note: Expected profile detection for tests/fixtures/nc/sinumerik (plan M8 §8.5). Owner: WP8.5.
One file per folder under tests/fixtures/nc, read by src/lib/core/profiles/detect.test.ts; the
margin over the best profile of another dialect is asserted and printed by
src/lib/data/profiles/fanucLathe.test.ts, which globs this folder too, and again by
src/lib/data/profiles/sinumerik.test.ts, which also scores long programs built from these files.
A value is a profile id, or 'fallback' when the content is inconclusive and the current
profile stays, or 'refused' when decodeFile does not open the file at all.
Klartext writes ';' comments as well, which is why §8.5 names it; on a turning program the
runner-up is the Fanuc lathe, because block numbers, G codes and G96/G97 score there. The profile
scores those lines the same way, so what decides is what only one of the two dialects writes.
SHAFT_OP20 and detect-sinumerik.txt carry no extension weight at all: they say whether the
content rules alone carry the dialect. The .MPF and .SPF files are written in upper case, the
way the control names them, and still count as mpf and spf.
